supplemental_items.interpretation: Parent-stop matching evaluates label, source and event in that order, then family: requested null permits null or empty, otherwise exact equality. Reset-leg accepts exact post type or base E/StopAll with a case-sensitive prefix match (not a number parser), then exact source and stop; no family check on that branch. Unrecognized causes are skipped. Multiple matching causes of one identity count once; multiple distinct identities yield null rather than picking earliest/nearest. The final physical formatter may itself return null.
supplemental_items.conditional_boundary: No empirical runtime or cross-owner acceptance asserted.
